clue.text: Like this answer, relative to 1 dn, in style of construction

definitions.text: Like this answer, relative to 1 dn
definitions.meaning: an across entry meets the down entry that shares its first square at a right angle
the late English Gothic architectural style named for its strong vertical lines

explanation.definitionFit: Across and down lights cross at right angles, and the same word names the upright late Gothic building style.

clue.text: Some beef, in short, Europe found affected

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A news-style line about European beef being hit, in brief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges SHORT and EUROPE; 'in short' looks like 'in brief' but 'short' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: This thick steak cut from the beef sirloin is a classic cut.

clue.text: Feel bewildered about book that's unconventional

indicators.note: the word for feeling bewildered goes around the letter for book

parts.note: to reel is to feel dizzy or confused

explanation.surface: Being puzzled by a book that breaks the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feel bewildered' looks like an anagram of FEEL but is REEL; 'about' puts it round B.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebel style or stance is nonconformist, defying convention.

clue.text: Trains voices

definitions.meaning: to voice something is to put it into words

explanation.definitionFit: Express trains run nonstop between major stations, and to voice an opinion is to state it in words.

clue.text: In crucial game, again played up?

indicators.note: in a down answer, up means the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: RE is a prefix meaning again
to dice is to gamble, to play at dice

explanation.surface: Asking whether, in a vital match, someone performed above themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the whole of RE + DICED.
explanation.definitionFit: A decider is the final game that settles a contest.

clue.text: Conservative/Socialist split

parts.note: socialists are the left in politics

explanation.surface: A rift between Tories and socialists.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleft is the past form of cleave, meaning split apart.

clue.text: Bookkeeper giving pound to S after winner's finish

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Bookkeeper giving pound to S after winner's finish': LIBRA (pound) + R (winner's finish) leaves IAN, which 'S' cannot give; the scan does not show this clue and the text looks misread.
annotationWithheld.clue: Bookkeeper giving pound to S after winner's finish

clue.text: Endless public disturbance in place of carnival

indicators.note: endless means the word's final letter is cut off

parts.note: a riot is a public disturbance

explanation.surface: Unending rioting at a carnival venue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' drops the last letter of RIOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro hosts the world-famous annual carnival.

clue.text: Beginners in chess realize a bishop is to move obliquely

indicators.note: the beginners of these words are their opening letters, picked from chess, realize, a and bishop

explanation.surface: Chess advice: a bishop is supposed to travel diagonally across the board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beginners in' takes the first letter of each of chess, realize, a and bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: To crab is to move sideways or slantwise, the way the crustacean scuttles.

clue.text: It's appropriate to reserve a place for notes

parts.note: to appropriate something is to pocket it, take it for yourself
to reserve a table or seat is to book it

explanation.surface: Someone thinks it fitting to book a seat somewhere to keep their written notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appropriate' looks like an adjective but is the verb, to take; 'notes' are banknotes, not jottings.
explanation.definitionFit: A pocketbook is a wallet or purse, somewhere you keep banknotes.

clue.text: Healthy colour, we hear, having taken in a lot of work

definitions.text: having taken in a lot of work

parts.note: healthy means well

indicators.note: says the next piece is a word that sounds like the colour, spelt differently

parts.note: red is a colour

explanation.surface: A ruddy, healthy complexion on someone who has done a great deal of labour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' marks that RED (colour) is spoken as READ, the past of read.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well-read has absorbed many books, a lot of literary work.

clue.text: Traditional material for covering yonder church

parts.note: yonder means that one over there

explanation.surface: Asking what old-fashioned stuff should roof the church over there.
explanation.definitionFit: Straw or reeds laid on roofs is the old-style roofing material.

clue.text: Secret agent replaced in most prominent position

indicators.note: replaced means put in a different place, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spy is swapped into the most prominent role.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle of the stage is where the main performer stands, the most prominent spot.

clue.text: Old-fashioned device for digital compression

parts.note: reads like modern data-compression technology, but digits here are fingers and thumbs squeezed in a torture instrument

explanation.definitionFit: This historic torture tool crushed a victim's thumbs, the digits of the hand.

clue.text: It blended with spirit of New York area

definitions.meaning: It is Italian vermouth, mixed with whiskey in a cocktail
the borough at the heart of New York City

explanation.definitionFit: The cocktail mixes whiskey with Italian vermouth, and the same name is the central borough of New York City.

clue.text: Fish, in small quantity — rough a bite

parts.note: a whit is a tiny amount

indicators.note: rough means roughly handled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fish taking only a little nibble.
explanation.definitionFit: Whitebait are tiny young fish eaten whole.

clue.text: Island on edge of Atlantic

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the edge of a word here is its opening letter, taken from Atlantic

explanation.surface: Describes an island lying at the rim of the Atlantic Ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edge of' takes the A of Atlantic. The whole clue also describes the island: Iona lies off Scotland's west coast, in the Atlantic.
explanation.definitionFit: This small Hebridean isle, famous for its abbey, sits off western Scotland facing the open Atlantic.

clue.text: Manage to conceal one's dishonour

indicators.note: the word for manage hides the letter for one inside it

parts.note: to manage a business is to run it
one is I, the Roman numeral; the 's is the link 'has'

explanation.surface: Someone tries to keep their disgrace secret.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruin a person, in older usage, was to bring them to disgrace or dishonour.

clue.text: Where trains are stopped by a railway, not moving

parts.note: trains halt at a station

explanation.surface: A stretch of track by a station where halted trains sit still.
explanation.definitionFit: Stationary means standing still, not in motion.

clue.text: Like secular circle set up, not connected with community

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: in a down answer, set up means the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: laic means lay, secular
a circle is shaped like O

explanation.surface: Something like a secular group being formed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns LAIC + O into OCIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Asocial means avoiding social contact, not engaging with others.

clue.text: Cricket side at Oval scored smoothly

parts.note: the leg side is one half of a cricket field
taken as written
an oval shape resembles the letter O

explanation.surface: A cricket team at the Oval ground scored runs with ease.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oval is a London cricket ground, so 'scored' looks like batting; it means written in a musical score.
explanation.definitionFit: Legato is the musical direction to play notes smoothly joined, as written in a score.

clue.text: Volunteer belonging to force joining monarch

parts.note: of means belonging to
F is the physics symbol for force
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A volunteer from the armed forces joins the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: To offer is to volunteer something.

clue.text: Director's position is less than fine

definitions.meaning: a film or stage director stands over the cast, in charge of the actors
weather that is cloudy and grey, not fine

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it puts the director above the actors; as one it describes a cloudy sky, weather that is not fine.

clue.text: Before start of play, cheerleader gets flowers

indicators.note: one piece comes before the other

parts.note: read as cheer leader: the leading letter of the word cheer
Act I is the start of a play

explanation.surface: A cheerleader is given a bouquet before the game begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Before' puts C (cheerleader) ahead of ACT I; 'flowers' means things that flower, not blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Cacti are plants that bloom, things that flower.

clue.text: Part of continent with organised safari etc.

indicators.note: organised means put into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A region of Africa suggested by arranged safaris and so on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' signals rearranging the letters of the two words that follow; 'with' looks like a link but supplies its abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: This region is the western portion of the African continent.

clue.text: Amount of work — Grenadier Guards have it both ways

indicators.note: the guardsmen's name holds the word forward across the gap and backward at its start

explanation.surface: Soldiers of a famous regiment want to have it both ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'have it both ways' signals the word inside: grenadiER Guards and, read backwards, GREnadier.
explanation.definitionFit: The erg is a unit of work or energy in physics.

clue.text: Talking bird

definitions.meaning: a small songbird such as the stonechat

explanation.definitionFit: Chat is informal talk, and the stonechat and whinchat are small birds named chats.

clue.text: Attack on officer, an all-out effort

indicators.note: in an across answer, one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: a general is a senior army officer
to strike is to attack

explanation.surface: An assault on a military officer, a no-holds-barred effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' places attack after officer, as in an across light; 'all-out' points to every worker coming out at once.
explanation.definitionFit: A general strike is a stoppage by workers across all industries, everybody coming out at once.
